findings.title: In-memory rate limiting not HA-safe
findings.description: Chat rate limits (10 msgs/min) and presence data stored in-memory; both reset on restart. For distributed deployments, migrate to Redis or comparable store; for single-instance development, acceptable as-is. Document this constraint in deployment guide.

findings.title: Role sync gap in presence recovery
findings.description: PresenceService recovers presence from AuctionParticipantConnection on restart but must fetch role/teamId from RoomMember table because those fields aren't stored in the connection record. If a user is removed from RoomMember between disconnect and recovery, their presence reappears with role SPECTATOR (fallback). Unlikely in normal operations but worth noting: role data should be persisted in AuctionParticipantConnection for consistency.

findings.title: Chat message held status not fully wired
findings.description: RoomChatService.getHeldMessages() currently filters by VISIBLE status but schema supports HELD and REMOVED statuses. Comment acknowledges schema needs a column to track held vs visible at database level. Current implementation works (held messages stored with status='HELD') but the getHeldMessages query needs updating once schema is fixed to properly filter held-only messages for moderation queue.
